_help: Moment.Labs social media identity. Edit here — no workflow changes needed.
_cover_style_tip: dark | light | glass — affects the social cover card background
_device_type_tip: all | phone | desktop — 'all' shows iPhone+Android+MacBook+Desktop in one composite mockup
_bg_rotation_tip: true = pick a random background image from wallpaper/backgrounds/gaming/ each run; false = use first image always
_mockup_layout_tip: quad = 2×2 grid with all 4 devices; single = one device centred

cover_card._tip: Text overlaid on the cover image that leads the social post
cover_card.tagline: One tap. Any screen. Pure vibe.

dm_page._tip: Last slide in the social carousel — call to action
dm_page.headline: Want this for FREE?
dm_page.body:
Drop a DM  👇
We'll send the full pack.

watermark._tip: Short text stamped on every generated image. Leave blank to disable.

_telegram_tip: Send a Telegram message when a batch completes. Uses notifications/config.json for the token.
